newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African April gold/forex reserves 14.4 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African April gold/forex reserves 14.4 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's combined gold and foreign exchange reserves rose 1.3 billion rand in April to 14.4 billion rand from March's 13.12 billion rand, when they rose 625.72 million rand, Reserve Bank figures show.
The central bank also said in a statement that the use of foreign credit lines at the end of the month was unchanged at 2.5 billion rand.
A detailed breakdown of the figures would be published on May 8, it said.
